profile.headline: Go, Kubernetes, and GPUs | NVIDIA Senior Engineer

positions.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft Azure · Go · Linux · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Terraform · Bash · Kubernetes · Go (Programming Language) · Cloud Computing

positions.title: DevOps Engineer III
positions.description:
As a DevOps manager, I plan, prioritize, and execute on most of the company-wide initiatives that impact our cloud infrastructure and software delivery. I proposed and led the effort to move 10+ engineering teams off of manually created infrastructure and onto Terraform IaC. This included creating a library of Terraform modules, kickstarting a self-service catalog of common infrastructure resources, and importing existing infra into a Terraform state. 

Over the last few months, cost savings has become top priority. My team led a cost optimization effort that saved the company over $60K/mo through a combination of identifying and destroying unused resources and rightsizing over-provisioned resources. 

In addition to company-wide initiatives, I have taken on several process improvements within the DevOps team in order to maximize efficiency, largely driven by a team size reduction. I made changes in our on-call system, our customer delivery pipeline, and our team ownership boundaries in order to make the DevOps team more successful in spite of being less than half the size.

positions.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
-Led the adoption and migration of 100+ code repositories from Bitbucket to Gitlab across 10+ teams.
-Developed CICD pipeline templates using Python, Bash, and Jsonnet that adhere to CICD best practices, including build-once-deploy-anywhere artifacts, security and quality gates, and rollbacks.
-Created a suite of automation tooling to streamline the creation of new customer environment using Terraform, Ansible, Python, and Bash.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer, Cloud Engineering
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft Azure · Go · Linux · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Terraform · Bash · Kubernetes · Go (Programming Language) · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Software Development Engineer, NKS
positions.description:
-Designed and developed in Golang the cluster provision system that is the backbone of "NKS" (NetApp Kubernetes Service), a multi-cloud, production-grade, managed Kubernetes offering that leverages several upstream Kubernetes SIG (special interest group) projects.
-Built Ansible playbooks and provided documentation for the support team to provide services to NKS customers more efficiently.
-Collaborated with front-end team to design and develop an API for the build system using gRPC.
-Contributed to Cluster API Kubernetes SIG via Github pull requests and issues, Zoom office hours and Slack discussions.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
-Operated and iterated on "DDEV Live", a Kubernetes-based web-hosting platform and deployment pipeline for hundreds of CMS websites.
-Established and executed plan to deliver 99.99% uptime guarantee by implementing self-healing HA platform with resource-based autoscaling.
-Configured and tuned observability and monitoring stack using Prometheus metrics and alert dashboard, Fluentd, and LogDNA, with VictorOps and Slack integrations, which provided the foundation for new on-call rotations.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Terraform · Bash · Kubernetes · Go (Programming Language) · Cloud Computing

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
-Built automation tooling around standing up and maintaining Kubernetes clusters for several environments, such as local, staging, prod, and our failover clusters.
-Worked closely with the development team to ensure their services meet Kubernetes best practices for resources requirements, metrics, logging, fault tolerance, and security. 
-Stayed up-to-date on Kubernetes' quick release cycles and the many features, bug fixes, and stability improvements they bring. 
-Implemented a custom Kubernetes Operator, a Vault secret management system, logging and metrics systems, RBAC, and more.
-Leveraged numerous AWS services for various projects and solutions such as EC2, ELB, ASG, S3, EBS, VPC, and RDS.
-Designed reusable Terraform-managed infrastructure projects for various non-Kubernetes (typically stateful) workloads.
-Troubleshooted by sifting through logs and monitoring tools to find the root cause, fix it, take measures to prevent it from happening again.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Led year-long effort to move deployment platform from Puppet to Kubernetes, which includes adopting supporting technologies such as Stackpoint.io, Helm, Minikube, ELK stack, Kubectl, and Calico network policies.
-Developed a set of Golang and Bash tools to automate deployments and bootstrap dev machines with a local Minikube cluster.
-Containerized / Dockerized PHP, Golang, and Node applications and wrote manifest files to bring them to life in a Kubernetes cluster.
-Provided training and Confluence documentation to ease devs onto Kubernetes.
-Built and supported applications that leverage various AWS services, such as EC2, RDS, S3, ECS, VPC, and more.
-Wide variance of experience building and supporting PHP, MySQL, Golang, and AngularJS applications.
-Configured New Relic monitoring and dashboards for application analytics.
-Created front-end test-driven development standards that leverage Karma, Jasmine, and IE virtual machines.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Developed applications in C#/.NET.
-Built tools to manage and sync data between Azure and on-prem servers.
-Wrote custom reports in SQL based on customer needs.

positions.title: Web Programmer
positions.description:
-Developed UIs in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for web-to-print, variable-data print products. 
-Trained other associates on UI development.

positions.title: Reporter - The Daily
positions.description:
-Networked with campus staff, administration, and student body to produce accurate, insightful, and interesting content.
-Worked the news and lifestyles beats on an award-winning daily newspaper.

positions.title: News Editor - The Daily
positions.description:
-Edited and managed news section content for an award winning daily newspaper.
-Worked closely with reporters to develop story content in ways that were interesting and relevant to our readership.
-Hosted bi-weekly meetings with various members of the UW community to gain insight into campus goings-on.
-Collaborated on a daily basis with editor-in-chief, photo editor, and other sub-editors to develop compelling multimedia storytelling.
